module: Manages fullscreen blur rectangles drawn behind the interface (scenetree.ScreenBlurFX effect). The rectangles are stored in groups in M.blurRects; at each onPreRender they are sent to addFrameBlurRect. Normalized coordinates: (0,0) at top left, (1,1) at bottom right.
usage:
ui_gameBlur.replaceGroup('myPanel', { {0, 0.15, 1, 0.8, 1} })  -- x, y, w, h, opacity
ui_gameBlur.removeGroup('myPanel')
notes: Each rectangle is a table {x, y, width, height, alpha} (indices 1 to 5), the color is ColorF(1,1,1,alpha).
Nothing is drawn if the CEF UI is hidden (ui_visibility.getCef()), unless the test_singleLevelLong extension is loaded, nor if an OpenXR session is running.
Bug: M.onExtensionLoaded, M.onExtensionUnloaded and M.setColor are assigned from local variables that are never defined, so they are nil.
addToGroup and removeFromGroup exist but are not exported; only replaceGroup, removeGroup and removeAllGroups are public.

blurRects.desc: Group -> list of rectangles {x, y, w, h, alpha}.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Always nil (reference to an undefined variable).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Always nil (reference to an undefined variable).

setColor.desc: Always nil (reference to an undefined variable).

replaceGroup.desc: Replaces all the rectangles of a group with the given list.

data.desc: List of rectangles {x, y, w, h, alpha}.

removeAllGroups.desc: Removes all the blur rectangle groups.

onPreRender.desc: Pre-render hook: sends each rectangle to the ScreenBlurFX (addFrameBlurRect) if the UI is visible.
